title: StyleBoxFlat Stops Showing Linking Icon When Dragging and Dropping Theme Override Templates
body: ### Tested versions v4.7.2.stable.mono.official [ed1daf0bf] ### System information Godot v4.7.2.stable.mono - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Direct3D 12 (Mobile) - dedicated Intel(R) Iris(R) Xe Graphics (Intel Corporation; 32.0.101.5542) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-1255U (12 threads) - 15.67 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono) ### Issue description Dragging and dropping theme overrides are an extremely fast way to build a fancy looking project. If the linking button breaks, where several style slots share the same theme template (eg. normal and pressed) then it makes it much harder. In the below image, these 2 style slots have the exact same theme template. Neither of them work. Please do game devs a favor and fix this🙏. ### Steps to reproduce 1. I used a button node for this. 2. I dragged "normal" under theme overrides to "pressed" and it linked without showing the linking icon- i cannot unlink the pressed theme I want to adjust. 3. restarting my project from godot launcher did not change this. 4. nothing broke except for the themes and no error messages either. My root scene node is a user interface node scene. Keep in mind I may be getting on the end of a larger project in terms of nodes in scene tree, but Godot's performance is lovely (complements to the dev) but this is a big issue for me. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) n/a I tried to record with OBS but when i tried using display capture and game capture it showed a gray screen with black bars down the top and bottom.
